name: ikariam-image-cache
description: Chrome/Firefox extension that bundles Ikariam skin images into the extension and serves them locally. The game server has no HTTP/2 and no keep-alive, so every image costs a fresh TCP+TLS handshake (~0.79s), and a 24h Cache-Control lifetime re-triggers it daily.

scripts.setup: node scripts/discover.mjs && node scripts/scrape-assets.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
